supportingSources.label: Daniele Celestino Acciari at UK Open 2025

strategy.summary: Prepare All Shook Up, start Heartbreak Hotel or Jailhouse Rock Multiball, then combine the song with TCB 2x playfield scoring and repeat the protected Jackpot shot.

quickInfo.name: Heartbreak Hotel Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the upper hotel until its door opens, then lock through the doorway to start the feature.

quickInfo.name: Jailhouse Rock Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Use the saucer to qualify and collect locks; its Jackpots and Super return to the saucer.

quickInfo.name: All Shook Up
quickInfo.summary: Complete the left loop, left ramp, and right ramp; it is easy to prepare for a multiball stack.

quickInfo.name: Other Featured Hits
quickInfo.summary: Hound Dog is a switch frenzy, while Blue Suede Shoes qualifies and then repeats the upper inner loop.

quickInfo.name: TCB 2x playfield scoring
quickInfo.summary: Complete the T-C-B targets for a timed double that applies to modes and Multiballs and can be extended at Scarf.

quickInfo.name: Graceland
quickInfo.summary: Start all five Featured Hits, collect every Gift from E-L-V-I-S, and reach number one in Top Ten Countdown to light the top saucer.

steps.text: Use ball save to test the hotel entry, Jailhouse saucer, left loop, and both ramp returns. Drop catch a clean Jailhouse eject on the lower-right flipper.
Collect two of All, Shook, and Up; leave the safest final shot uncollected while a Multiball is nearly ready.
Use the upper playfield to prepare Heartbreak Hotel, or use the saucer to prepare Jailhouse Rock.
Complete T-C-B for 20 seconds of 2x playfield scoring when its final target can be made without sacrificing the ball.
Start the prepared Multiball, then finish All Shook Up inside the protected window.
Repeat the feature's Jackpot shot and use the Scarf target for add-a-ball only from a controlled feed.
modeNotes: Jailhouse sequence: Saucer Jackpots advance J-A-I-L-B-R-E-A-K and its saucer Super Jackpot.

fallback.title: Heartbreak Hotel only
fallback.when: Use this when the upper hotel is reliable but the Jailhouse saucer or TCB targets reject.

steps.text: Use the left ramp to enter the upper playfield.
Hit the hotel until its door opens, then shoot through the doorway to lock the ball.
During Heartbreak Hotel Multiball, shoot the hotel to open its door, then enter before it closes for the escalating Heartbreak award.

alternatives.title: Hound Dog spinner
alternatives.when: Use this when Hound Dog is ready and the left loop is the safest repeatable shot.

steps.text: Start Hound Dog at its target.
Rip the left-loop spinner for dense switch scoring.
Let the timer expire rather than forcing the target to extend it from a bad feed.
Start Hound Dog, Blue Suede Shoes, All Shook Up, Heartbreak Hotel Multiball, and Jailhouse Rock Multiball.
Complete the Gifts from E-L-V-I-S progression.
Advance through the Top Ten Countdown, then start Graceland at the top saucer.

techniques.name: Prepared song stack
techniques.instruction: Leave one safe All Shook Up shot uncollected, then finish it after Multiball and TCB are active.

cautions.issue: The Jailhouse saucer is narrow and may collect from the bumpers rather than a direct shot.
cautions.response: Do not force a centerline attempt when a safer bumper feed or other Multiball is available.

checkBeforePlay: Test both ramps, upper flippers, hotel door, Jailhouse saucer eject, loop magnet, T-C-B and KING standups, and Scarf target before choosing the stack.
strategy.simpleOverview: In Elvis, completing Featured Hits awards Gifts and advances Top Ten Countdown toward Graceland. Prepare the safe final shot of All Shook Up, build Heartbreak Hotel or Jailhouse Rock, then complete T-C-B and start the Multiball before finishing the song under 2x playfield scoring and extra-ball protection.
strategy.overview: In Elvis, completing Featured Hits awards Gifts and advances Top Ten Countdown toward Graceland. For the repeatable scoring route, prepare All Shook Up and either primary Multiball, complete T-C-B for 2x playfield scoring, start the Multiball, then finish the song while the extra balls protect its Jackpot shots.
machineSetup: Test both ramps, upper flippers, hotel door, Jailhouse saucer eject, loop magnet, T-C-B and KING standups, and Scarf target before choosing the stack.
